skill.name: wecomcli-smartpage
skill.description: 企业微信智能文档（smartpage）操作技能。能够新建文档、导入 .md 为文档、读取文档内容、修改文档内容（整页重写、局部编辑、增删子页面）、上传附件到文档，以及搭建带看板/图表的数据系统页面和信息收集表单页面。当用户提及文档，智能文档，智能主页、提供 https://doc.weixin.qq.com/smartpage/xxx 或 https://page.weixin.qq.com/smartpage/xxx 链接、要求整理成文档，或表达"新建文档""把 md 导入成文档"等未指定文档类型的需求时，也应使用本技能。
skill.summary: Create, read, and edit WeCom Smartpage documents, with workflows for attachments, charts, and data collection forms.
skill.author: wecomteam

security_audit.summary: All 90 static matches are false positives involving Markdown syntax, readable Chinese documentation, service URL examples, and a temporary import file. One semantic issue remains: document-controlled image URLs are downloaded with redirects without destination validation, creating an SSRF risk. No evidence found of malware, credential theft, or audit-directed prompt injection in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: The image analysis workflow downloads document-controlled URLs without validating their destinations or redirects.
remediation.suggestion: Require HTTPS and approved image hosts; reject private, loopback, and link-local destinations after DNS resolution and at every redirect. Apply download size and timeout limits.

semantic_findings.title: Unvalidated Document Image Downloads
semantic_findings.description: The workflow collects every image URL from document Markdown and downloads each using curl -sSL without destination validation. A document author could induce requests to internal services or attacker-controlled hosts, including through redirects.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The workflow explicitly turns document image references into network requests and enables redirect following without scheme, host, or address restrictions. Exploitability depends on host network access and downloader safeguards.

content.user_title: Create and Edit WeCom Smartpage Documents
content.value_statement: Maintaining structured WeCom documents requires coordinated page, content, and data updates. This skill guides CLI workflows for document imports, precise edits, attachments, charts, and forms.
actual_capabilities: Create empty Smartpage documents or import local Markdown and MDX files.
Read page hierarchies and retrieve page content as Markdown, text, or blocks.
Create, rename, move, delete, and change the layout of document pages.
Append page content, replace whole pages, or edit individual blocks.
Upload local images and attachments to a selected document space.
Build database-backed charts and forms, with table configuration delegated to wecomcli-smartsheet.
limitations: Requires an installed, configured wecom-cli and prerequisite checks from the separate wecomcli-shared skill.
Published Smartpage links are read-only; editing requires an editable document link.
Document search, permissions, and table record management require companion skills.
PDF or Word export, comments, history, and recovery require the WeCom client; image understanding requires host image capabilities.

prompt_templates.title: Read a Document
prompt_templates.prompt: Read [document link] and summarize the named pages and their main points. Do not change any content. Use text only.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: inspect an existing Smartpage document.

prompt_templates.title: Import a Markdown Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Import [local Markdown file] as a new Smartpage document. Ask me for its Chinese title, preserve the headings, and return the document link.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: create a document from an existing file.

prompt_templates.title: Edit One Section
prompt_templates.prompt: In [document link], update [section] on [page name] with [replacement text]. Read current content first and preserve all other blocks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: make a precise change without replacing a page.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Data Collection Dashboard
prompt_templates.prompt: Build an event registration form and attendance dashboard in [editable document link]. Configure built-in tables through wecomcli-smartsheet before adding controls, submission formulas, and charts.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate table setup, form controls, and chart components.

output_examples.input: Summarize the project overview page using text only.
output: Project status: Testing is in progress.
Completed work: The team finished the initial review.
Next step: Resolve the remaining issues before release.

output_examples.input: Update one section of the release page while preserving the remaining content.
output_examples.output: Updated the requested section on the release page. Other blocks and page structure remain unchanged.

output_examples.input: Edit a document using its published Smartpage link.
output_examples.output: This link opens a published, read-only document. Please provide the editable Smartpage link before making changes.

best_practices: Read the current page and confirm the target before editing; use block-level changes for local updates.
Create built-in table fields before adding charts or submission buttons that reference them.
Confirm deletions and full-page replacements explicitly; validate image destinations before downloading document images.
anti_patterns: Using a full-page overwrite to change one paragraph or component.
Inventing document, page, or block identifiers instead of retrieving actual values.
Using static Markdown import for forms or charts that require built-in database fields.

faq.question: What must be installed before using this skill?
faq.answer: You need a configured wecom-cli and the separate wecomcli-shared skill for prerequisite checks.

faq.question: Can I create a document from a Markdown file?
faq.answer: Yes. The import workflow accepts a local Markdown or MDX file and creates a new Smartpage document.

faq.question: Can it edit published documents?
faq.answer: No. Published links are read-only. Provide an editable Smartpage link for modifications.

faq.question: Can it change one component without replacing the whole page?
faq.answer: Yes. It reads the current block tree and uses block-level editing to preserve unrelated content.

faq.question: Does it manage permissions or database records directly?
faq.answer: It delegates document administration to wecomcli-doc-manage and table operations to wecomcli-smartsheet.

faq.question: Can it export documents or restore deleted content?
faq.answer: No. Use the WeCom client for exports and recovery. Page deletion and full-page replacement require explicit confirmation.
